blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Exactly a year after a magnitude 6.9 earthquake devastated northern Cebu, Bogo City is slowly getting back on its feet. A clear sign of that recovery will take place on the basketball court, with Bogo City’s under-18 team set to compete in the Governor’s Cup U-18 Basketball Tournament on October 4. The team will open its campaign at the Don Celestino Martinez Sr. Sports Complex in Bogo City.
